orders.summary:
I judged candidate assembled-0342 (body-0340, leg reshape v7 with zBlur) against baseline assembled-0336-q, with R08 as the target. The full result is written to C:\dev\src\xalians-akinza-loop\untracked\species-construction\akinza\loop\packets\assembled-0342-u\critique.json.

**No diff.json.** The packet command never wrote one, so I recomputed it with the loop_tools rule. m02, m03, m08, m09 and m10 changed, so I judged R08, R09, R10, R11 and R12.

**R08 (Legs): better than baseline, same grades.**
- What improved: the shading bands across the shin are gone, the step under the knee is smaller (8 px against 12 px), and the ankles are slimmer (.033 against .0345).
- Visual results: R08.1, R08.2, R08.4 and R08.9 stay partial; R08.3 stays pass.
- Measured results: R08.5 to R08.8 pass. R08.10 (.8351) and R08.11 (.6422) fail, and both are lower than the baseline. build.json says a 2.5 px framing jump in the posed packet causes the drop; I did not verify that.

**Side effect: the leg change damaged a tail.** The leg mask is a box the tail passes through. The lowest tail now has a kink on its lower edge where it crosses the leg, visible in m10 tail-fan-back and m02 back. Because of this, R10.6 drops from partial to fail. There is also a new shading band across the lower thigh, which falls under R12.3 (already fail). Every other R09, R10, R11 and R12 result is the same as before.

**Measured criteria and invariants.** I copied the measured criteria for every region. R06.10 (.8475), R07.6 (.8478) and R09.9 (.6973) also fall with the same framing jump. Every invariant holds except I05, which is still open and no worse.

**Issues for the next R08 order:**
1. Mask the leg warps by mesh part so the tail is excluded (fixability .9).
2. Spread the calf swell in profile and pull the lower back line forward .005 to .008 so the ankle and heel taper (fixability .6).
3. Fill the hollow under the kneecap, and fade the zBlur out at its upper edge so it stops leaving a band (fixability .6).
